name: Labrujasuchus
sum: Labrujasuchus is a shuvosaurid poposauroid that outwardly resembled ornithomimosaur dinosaurs, from the Norian Hayden Quarry (Chinle Formation) of New Mexico.
wsnote: No body-length estimate is given in the sources consulted.
holotype: A partial associated skeleton from the H2 paleochannel of the Hayden Quarry, Ghost Ranch, collected in 2006: forelimb and shoulder girdle elements, pubic and hindlimb material and parts of vertebrae; catalogue number not given on the page.
biology: The sources consulted give no direct evidence of diet or habits.
author: Turner et al. 2026

sources.text: Turner, A. H., Kernan, C. E., Laing, A., Pritchard, A. C., Stocker, M. R., Irmis, R. B., Smith, N. D., Werning, S. and Nesbitt, S. J. 2026. A new shuvosaurid (Archosauria, Poposauroidea) from the Late Triassic (Norian) Hayden Quarry of New Mexico, U.S.A. Journal of Vertebrate Paleontology.

dates_note: No PBDB occurrences. Mid Norian (about 211 Ma) per English Wikipedia; whole ICS Norian stage used.
